scope: Theorem 1.3 (Finite-set central splitting) of the manuscript “Tracial projection methods and uniform property Gamma” (preprints/Tracial-projection-methods-and-uniform-property-Gamma-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 291 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 11c90e4d0861aa3f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 4. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let A ⊆ D be a unital inclusion of C∗-algebras, with A nuclear, D of real rank zero, and T(D) ̸= ∅. Suppose that for every δ > 0 there is a full projection g ∈ D with supτ∈T(D) τ(g) < δ. For every finite K ⊆ U(A) and ε > 0 there is a projection P ∈ D such that, for every x ∈ K, sup τ∈T(D) ∥[P, x]∥2,τ < ε, sup τ∈T(D) |τ(Px) − 1 2τ(x)| < ε.
